goal: Prevent fee-bumped transactions from getting an earlier locktime than the transaction they replace
Stop an on-chain fingerprint that identifies Bitcoin Core and Electrum wallet users when bumping fees
agreement: Substantive support after resolving edge cases around stale chains and off-by-one errors (nervana21, molnard)
Verified by local test runs across multiple revisions (molnard, nervana21)
Approach approval without detailed technical feedback (polespinasa)
Suggestions to refine code structure and comments remain under discussion (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it fixes an on-chain privacy leak that affects under two percent of fee replacements
Removes a distinct fingerprint identifying Bitcoin Core or Electrum users who bump transaction fees
